# TEVM

> In-memory Ethereum Virtual Machine and full node for TypeScript, powered by native Zig (ZEVM) and Viem. Built publicly on Smithers Cloud.

- Public Coding Factory: https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm
- Authenticated MCP Endpoint: https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/mcp
- Shared Build Object Store: https://build.smithers.sh
- GitHub Mirror: https://github.com/evmts/tevm

## Introduction

- [TEVM Node](https://node.tevm.sh/index.md)
- [Architecture](https://node.tevm.sh/introduction/architecture-overview.md): How MemoryClient, ZevmEngine, Server transports, ZEVM, Voltaire, and Guillotine Mini divide ownership and process requests
- [What is Tevm?](https://node.tevm.sh/introduction/what-is-tevm-node.md): An in-process native Ethereum node for Node.js, backed by ZEVM, Voltaire, and Guillotine Mini, with viem-native APIs and Solidity bundler plugins
- [Why embed an EVM?](https://node.tevm.sh/introduction/why-run-ethereum-in-js.md): Why Tevm exists — TypeScript + EVM in one process, native execution speed, direct Solidity imports, and instant test isolation

## Getting Started

- [Tutorial: Solidity Bundler](https://node.tevm.sh/getting-started/bundler.md): Import .sol files directly into TypeScript with full ABI types, bytecode, and IDE hover support
- [Tutorial: Ethers v6](https://node.tevm.sh/getting-started/ethers.md): Connect ethers v6 to Tevm with TevmProvider or BrowserProvider
- [Quickstart](https://node.tevm.sh/getting-started/overview.md): Install Tevm, run your first in-process Ethereum transaction, deploy bytecode, and fork a live chain in 60 seconds
- [Community](https://node.tevm.sh/getting-started/testimonials.md): What developers are saying about Tevm and how to reach the team
- [Tutorial: Viem](https://node.tevm.sh/getting-started/viem.md): Use Tevm as a batteries-included viem client or attach createTevmTransport to a minimal tree-shakeable viem client

## Core Architecture

- [Client & Engine Options](https://node.tevm.sh/core/create-tevm-node.md): Complete configuration reference for createMemoryClient, createTevmTransport, and createZevmEngine
- [Forking Upstream Chains](https://node.tevm.sh/core/forking.md): Overlay local native execution on an upstream EVM JSON-RPC endpoint at a pinned block
- [Accounts, Storage & Snapshots](https://node.tevm.sh/core/managing-state.md): Inspect and mutate accounts, code, and storage slots, rewind state with snapshots, and serialize portable ZEVM state blobs
- [Migrating from the JS Engine](https://node.tevm.sh/core/migration-from-js-engine.md): Concrete mapping from the legacy EthereumJS-based Tevm engine to the native ZEVM engine
- [Mining & Block Production](https://node.tevm.sh/core/mining-modes.md): Configure automining, manual mining, and interval mining in Tevm, and observe mined blocks
- [Runtime Model & ZEVM](https://node.tevm.sh/core/runtime-model.md): How Tevm embeds ZEVM, Voltaire, and Guillotine Mini, and where Tevm
- [Engine API (ZevmEngine)](https://node.tevm.sh/core/tevm-node-interface.md): Low-level Node-API wrapper over ZEVM — serialized request(), raw rpc(), lifecycle events, and NativeRpcError

## API Reference

- [Account Management](https://node.tevm.sh/api/account-management.md): Read and write account balance, nonce, bytecode, and storage slots with tevmGetAccount, tevmSetAccount, tevmDeal, and PREFUNDED_ACCOUNTS
- [Decorators (Removed in Native Engine)](https://node.tevm.sh/api/decorators.md): How native ZevmEngine and viem client extensions replace the legacy @tevm/decorators package
- [Tracing & Engine Events](https://node.tevm.sh/api/evm-events.md): Capture native Guillotine Mini opcode traces with debug_traceCall and subscribe to ZevmEngine lifecycle events
- [JSON-RPC Reference](https://node.tevm.sh/api/json-rpc.md): Namespaces, wire formatting rules, error codes, and transport boundaries for Tevm
- [MCP Server for AI Agents](https://node.tevm.sh/api/mcp-server.md): Give Claude, Cursor, Codex, or Antigravity isolated native EVM sessions, Solidity compilation, forking, and opcode tracing with @tevm/mcp
- [Client Methods Map](https://node.tevm.sh/api/methods.md): Quick-reference map of every method surface on MemoryClient and ZevmEngine
- [Package Overview](https://node.tevm.sh/api/packages.md): Every workspace package and subpath export in the Tevm monorepo
- [HTTP, WebSocket & IPC Server](https://node.tevm.sh/api/server.md): Expose a native Tevm engine over HTTP, WebSocket subscriptions, Unix IPC, Express, and Next.js with @tevm/server and @tevm/http-client
- [Call, Contract & Deploy](https://node.tevm.sh/api/tevm-call.md): Complete API reference for tevmCall, tevmContract, and tevmDeploy — simulations, state overrides, transactions, deployments, and revert data
- [VM & Submodules](https://node.tevm.sh/api/vm-and-submodules.md): How native ZEVM, Voltaire, and Guillotine Mini replace the legacy JavaScript VM submodules

## Examples

- [Browser Trace Viewer](https://node.tevm.sh/examples/debugger-ui.md): Pair a local @tevm/server with a browser UI that calls debug_traceCall and renders Guillotine Mini opcode steps
- [Ethers v6 Cookbook](https://node.tevm.sh/examples/ethers.md): Deploy contracts, send transactions, and manipulate local state with ethers v6 and TevmProvider
- [Forking Mainnet](https://node.tevm.sh/examples/forking-mainnet.md): Fork live mainnet or L2 state locally, impersonate whales, simulate swaps, and run deterministic local fork tests
- [Testing with Vitest](https://node.tevm.sh/examples/local-testing.md): Write fast, isolated, deterministic smart-contract tests with Tevm and Vitest — snapshots, time travel, deployments, and revert traces
- [Viem Cookbook](https://node.tevm.sh/examples/viem.md): Practical patterns for using viem public, wallet, test, and TEVM actions on one native engine

## Advanced Guides

- [Custom Precompiles (Removed in Native Engine)](https://node.tevm.sh/advanced/custom-precompiles.md): Status of JavaScript custom precompiles in the native ZEVM engine and supported alternatives
- [Performance Profiling](https://node.tevm.sh/advanced/performance-profiler.md): Profile opcode gas consumption with native debug_traceCall traces
- [Receipts & Logs](https://node.tevm.sh/advanced/receipts-and-logs.md): Query mined receipts, block receipts, event logs, and live WebSocket log subscriptions
- [Transaction Pool](https://node.tevm.sh/advanced/txpool.md): Inspect pending and queued transactions with txpool_* JSON-RPC methods

## Engineering Wiki and Mythical History

- [Start here](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/start-here.md): Navigate TEVM's packages, native ZEVM core, and public Smithers Cloud coding factory.
- [TEVM layered architecture](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/architecture.md): Trace requests from the tevm facade through memory-client, actions, node, and native ZEVM.
- [Native ZEVM engine and Smithers dogfooding](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/zevm-native-engine.md): Explain how Smithers builds, pins, stamps, and caches native ZEVM, Voltaire, and Guillotine Mini.
- [JSON-RPC wire contract and error model](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/json-rpc-contract.md): Specify canonical hex encoding, negative error codes, BaseError hierarchy, and regression proof.
- [Smithers Cloud coding factory and trust boundary](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/coding-factory.md): Document QuickJS-planned flows, shared Smithers Cloud object store cache, and trusted vs untrusted execution.
- [Public authenticated MCP and one-time sandbox auth](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/mcp-and-byoa.md): Show how agents connect via OAuth 2.1 to smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/mcp and mint single-use sandbox tokens.
- [Lighthouse-style backpressure and Uphill audit](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/backpressure-and-uphill.md): Detail TEVM's continuous Uphill metrics across Footprint, Quality, Architecture, and Factory Health.
- [Automated release, GitHub mirror, and docs publishing](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/release-and-docs-pipeline.md): Trace how merges from Smithers Cloud to GitHub main trigger Changesets releases, docs, and llms.txt.
- [Mythical History](https://node.tevm.sh/wiki/mythical-history.md): Clean from-scratch epic timeline of TEVM.
